entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is this where we're supposed to be[n]meeting?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is she not here...? Try checking around.

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.en: Are you all by yourself?[n]Where did you come from?

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.en: Did you run away from home? What's[n]wrong, little girl?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That looks bad! What are you gonna do!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now's not the time for[n]that. Go save her!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're supposed to be watching over her[n]today! Go save her!

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.en: Hm. Well, can you come down to the[n]station with me for now?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: S-Sorry... I thought I conquered my fears[n]back at the beach...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There wasn't anyone I knew with me,[n]so I panicked. Felt like my heart was[n]gonna pop...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I got so scared all by myself... then I just[n]sorta curled up into a ball...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then all these people started staring at[n]me... and the police came... and then it[n]was all over...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look, Futaba. If you're ever in trouble, just[n]call [fName].

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hm... I feel kinda calm when we're this[n]close. You're okay being like this, right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Urgh... Couldn't even go buy a game by[n]myself. I'm a failure...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But I'm okay outside as long as it's with[n][fName]... Is he some kinda key item?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll try and get better at navigation if[n]you do!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, a deal! That good with you?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: For reals? Then it's a deal.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's just a figure of speech. I want you to[n]help me get better at going outside.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And in return, I'll work even harder as your[n]navigator. How's that for a good deal?
I should accompany Futaba when she goes[n]out from now on...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We were impressed with the intel-[n]gathering skills of the Phantom Thieves[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We also know that this would've been[n]impossible unless you had a skilled hacker...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new contract.[n]Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Use this new bond to strengthen your circle[n]of support.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All right! Now that that's over with, let's[n]goooo!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Weren't you bawling your eyes out just[n]a second ago?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, but I have my key item now! Victory[n]conditions met!
